caseno: Appeal from original decree No.51 of 1969.
lawyer:
Abdul Hamid Chowdhury ------ For the appellants. 
Md. Yeasin—For Respdt. No.1.
Shamsur Rahman ------ For Respdt. Nos. 3(a) to 3(ka).
parties:
Muzaffar Ali Bepari & others  ------ Appellants. 
Vs. 
Abdul Baser and others  ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: "That this partition suit be decreed in part on contest against defendants 1-3, 10-15, 17, 18 and 19 and ex parte against the rest in a preliminary form without costs. The parties do effect partition by metes and bounds in respect of the plaintiff's share of land measuring 6.80½ acres within six months hence, failing which the plaintiff may apply to this Court for a final decree according to the provisions of the C.P.C. The plaintiff shall be given as far as possible a compact saham and the convenience of possession of the parties shall also be kept in view. In schedule 'C' of the plaint, plot No. 1882 (.82 acres) appears to have been inserted by mistake as this land is not show in the relevant Khatian No.1510 but is shown in Khatian No. 92 Let this clerical error in the plaint be rectified before drawing up of the decree."
